French A1

Why learn French?

ಫ್ರೆಂಚ್ ಏಕೆ ಕಲಿಯಬೇಕು? A skill that opens doors for study, work and travel.

Why French

  • One of the six official languages of the United Nations
  • Used across several continents, in business, culture and diplomacy
  • Opens study options in France and other French-speaking countries
  • A skill that makes your CV stand out for international jobs
  • Helps with scholarships, exchange programmes and opportunities abroad

What is DELF?

DELF is the official French diploma for non-native speakers, awarded by France's Ministry of Education through France Éducation international. It has four levels, A1, A2, B1 and B2, and each is a separate diploma. A1 is the first.

  • Valid for life. The diploma never expires.
  • Recognised worldwide by universities and employers.
  • Official proof of your level, unlike a course certificate.
  • Study and work: higher levels (often B2) are asked for by many French universities. Always check each programme.
  • Start at A1. You can take any level without the earlier ones.

This course builds your French A1 foundation. The DELF exam itself is taken separately at an authorised centre such as Alliance Française.
